attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 uttargaya-shelter kakani-temple
load car1 elderly 3
load car1 adult 1
drive car1 kakani-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car1 elderly 3
unload car1 adult 1
drive car2 uttargaya-shelter bidur-temple
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 bidur-temple trishuli-village
load car2 injured 3
drive car2 trishuli-village bidur-temple
drive car2 bidur-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car2 injured 3
unload car2 adult 1
drive car2 uttargaya-shelter bidur-temple
load car2 adult 1
drive car2 bidur-temple syaphru-farm
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 syaphru-farm bidur-temple
drive car2 bidur-temple uttargaya-shelter
unload car2 elderly 3
unload car2 adult 1
defer kakani-temple adult 3
defer bidur-temple adult 1
</plan>
COST: 280

**Basis for the plan:**
- **Evacuation point:** Only Uttargaya shelter is used. Kakani temple is not designated, so nobody is dropped there.
- **Roads avoided:** Uttargaya–Syaphru is closed, Galchhi–Trishuli is washed out, and Uttargaya–Gajuri has fast floodwater with a recent truck loss.
- **Kakani (3 elderly, 4 adults):** Kakani is a dead end 48 minutes from Uttargaya, so one 96-minute round trip carries 3 elderly and 1 adult. Deferring the other 3 adults (60) is cheaper than a second 96-minute trip.
- **Trishuli and Bidur (3 injured, 3 adults at Bidur):** Car 2 carries the 3 injured plus 1 adult from Bidur (48 minutes).
- **Syaphru (3 elderly):** Car 2 carries the 3 elderly plus 1 adult from Bidur (56 minutes). The third Bidur adult is deferred (20), since a separate 34-minute trip would cost more than the penalty.

**Totals:** driving 200 minutes plus deferral penalties of 80 (4 adults) gives 280.

The 4 deferred adults (3 at Kakani, 1 at Bidur) should be first in line for the next wave.
